systemd_units.name: enable-linger.service
systemd_units.note: keeps user@1000.service alive without login sessions; prevents PulseAudio from dying when all SSH sessions close

systemd_units.name: pulseaudio-suspend-fix.service
systemd_units.note: one-shot: disables module-suspend-on-idle so USB audio stays visible to JS8Call

notes: v1.0.5: post-install hook auto-installs new systemd units from overlay; enable-linger.service (keeps user services alive without login sessions; fixes JS8Call audio dying after SSH close); pulseaudio-suspend-fix.service (disables module-suspend-on-idle so USB audio device stays visible to JS8Call)
milestone_summary: Fix three JS8Call audio failures: (1) linger not enabled — user@1000.service killed by logind after idle timeout, PulseAudio dies; (2) module-suspend-on-idle suspends USB audio codec, JS8Call can't see it; (3) update button now auto-installs new systemd units from overlay
